Title: Sr. Data Scientist, Financial Services Mexico
Description: Description Lead the development, validation, and governance of the full suite of risk models for a high-growth payment product in Mexico, directly shaping the analytical foundation that drives every business decision across the product lifecycle. If you thrive on building scorecards from the ground up — starting with external data and expert-rule frameworks when proprietary data does not yet exist, then architecting the transition to custom models as portfolio mature — this is your opportunity to establish and scale a risk modeling function from inception. As Sr. Data Scientist, you will own the end-to-end model roadmap spanning origination, behavioral, delinquency propensity, collections, recovery, analytical fraud, and reserve input models. You will define development standards, documentation practices, versioning protocols, and monitoring frameworks with the rigor required to withstand audit scrutiny and regulatory review. Your work is both tactical and strategic: you will manage complex, cross-functional model programs with negotiated and defined obligations, influencing roadmaps, business and technology decisions, and model governance across the organization. Success in this role is measured by discriminatory power (KS, Gini) and its stability over time, Population Stability Index (PSI) of variables and scores, development-to-implementation cycle time, and the absence of validation findings. In a new product, the first 12 to 18 months are typically operated with generic or bureau scorecards and expert rules; this role requires someone who knows how to launch without proprietary data and plan the deliberate transition to custom models built on proprietary performance data as vintages mature. Key job responsibilities You will own and execute the model roadmap covering origination scorecards, behavioral scorecards, delinquency propensity models, collections and recovery models, analytical fraud models, and reserve inputs (PD, LGD, EAD). You will manage the full model lifecycle: development, validation, approval, implementation, ongoing monitoring, recalibration, and retirement. You will develop the origination scorecard, including reject inference methodology, and lead feature engineering across external data sources, and partner transactional data. You will build behavioral scorecards,payment propensity, contactability, and recovery models and produce PD, LGD, and EAD inputs for reserves calculation. You will own model validation end-to-end: conducting conceptual soundness reviews, replicating results, performing stress testing and stability analysis, and issuing formal opinions with findings, severity classifications, and remediation timelines. You will produce complete technical documentation and model files to the standard required for third-party review. A day in the life You will join working sessions with the risk team to translate champion/challenger experiment results into model refinement priorities, and calibrate payment propensity and contactability models against real-world recovery outcomes. You will coordinate with engineering to validate that deployed model versions match approved specifications and prepare the model performance package for the credit and risk committees. About The Team We are a team at Amazon building a new business, and we sit within the Payments organization. Today the team is small by design, which means you will have an outsized role in shaping our credit risk function, processes, and culture from day one. Our closest partners span finance, technology, and commercial teams, and together we are investing in creating a world-class underwriting and credit risk capability. If you want to help define something new at Amazon and see your work directly reflected in the product, we would love to hear from you. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience 4+ years of data scientist experience Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression Preferred Qualifications 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience Experience managing data pipelines Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Supply Chain Business Insights
Description: Description Help shape the data foundation behind one of Amazon's fastest-growing supply chain networks — and put AI in the hands of the people who move millions of packages across Mexico every day. This is your chance to build the pipelines, analytics, and cloud-native solutions that turn raw data into trusted, accurate intelligence for an organization at the forefront of GenAI adoption. As a Business Intelligence Engineer on the MX Supply Chain BI team, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, reporting solutions, and analytical tools that power decisions across Mexico's Supply Chain — from network planning and capacity to last mile operations. You will work with large-scale datasets on AWS, write production-grade Python code, deploy cloud-based solutions, and partner with stakeholders across 10 functional areas to deliver insights that drive operational performance. You will contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform and help embed GenAI and ML capabilities into the analytics portfolio. Key job responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/big-data pipelines using AWS services following medallion-architecture best practices Write production-grade Python code for data transformation, automation, statistical analysis, and integration with AI/ML workflows Build high quality datasets with robust metadata for agents to consume and give insights to our stakeholders. Deploy and manage cloud-native data solutions on AWS through infrastructure-as-code based deployments. Collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain functional areas (Topology, S&OP, Network Planning, Middle Mile, Last Mile, Sort Centers, Operations) to translate business questions into analytical solutions Contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform (Apache Iceberg on serverless AWS), ensuring data quality, governance, and single-source-of-truth standards Write and optimize complex queries on SQL, Spark SQL and PySpark across large-scale datasets to support reporting, ad-hoc analysis, and metric development Establish and follow engineering best practices including code reviews, testing, monitoring, documentation, and logging best practices. Proactively identify opportunities to improve data availability, reduce time-to-insight, and automate manual reporting processes Support the team's GenAI/ML initiatives by preparing governed, high-quality datasets and contributing to data products that enable agentic and self-service AI workflows A day in the life You start your morning reviewing pipeline health dashboards and resolving any data quality alerts from overnight ETL runs. By mid-morning, you're deep in Python — building a new data transformation module. After a quick stand-up with your peers, you jump into a working session with a Last Mile stakeholder who needs a new metric added to their operational dashboard; you scope the requirement, write the code and push for your peers to review before lunch. You wrap up the day by prototyping a data integration that will expose a new dataset to the team's GenAI agent through the MCP — a small step that will let operations leaders ask natural-language questions about network speed and compliance. No two days are the same, but every day your work makes Supply Chain decisions faster, smarter, and more trusted. About The Team MX Supply Chain Business Insights owns the data, insights, and analytics that power how Amazon's Mexico Supply Chain organization understands its business, measures its customer experience, and makes decisions. The team serves 10 functional areas with growing cross-LATAM collaboration with Brazil. Our team works together to deliver the data infrastructure, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting that underpin MX Supply Chain's most critical business metrics, while also developing full stack applications to gather and process data. We are at an inflection point: as we embed GenAI across the portfolio and scale an AI-ready data lakehouse across LATAM, the decisions our stakeholders make depend on data they can trust, access quickly, and act on confidently. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling 3+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools Experience with AI/ML technologies Experience building and operating a cloud-based architecture Preferred Qualifications Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business Experience with forecasting and statistical analysis Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Analista de Datos y Estructuración de Energía

Conocimiento de SQL o algún lenguaje de programación para el armado de queries y consultas de datos, con el fin de construir herramientas de medición y agilizar soluciones y automatizaciones operativas. Title: Senior Associate, Data Analytics & Business Intelligence (BI), GOC
Description: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer, Data Operations who will: Design, build, and maintain cloud-based data solutions, supporting business intelligence, media performance reporting, and data quality compliance. Collaborate with data engineers, developers, and UX designers to develop data pipelines and workflows, managing the design, build, and maintenance phases of client reporting projects. Partner with Business Intelligence and Data Operations teams to define and document reporting and visualization requirements. Ensure data quality and provide ongoing support and maintenance for existing workspaces. Onboard new client teams to cloud data solutions, providing guidance and support throughout implementation. Define QA guidelines and automate existing quality assurance processes to improve accuracy and efficiency. Develop tools, processes, and best practices with support from the Associate Director to improve workflows and deliver value to client teams. Act as a subject matter expert in data quality, BI tools, and business rules, ensuring consistent application of best practices across projects. Coordinate status meetings and working sessions, tracking tasks and deliverables across multiple stakeholders and projects. Proactively identify, escalate, and resolve project roadblocks and delivery issues. Report to the US-based Associate Director, communicating project status, progress, and risks. Build collaborative relationships with internal teams, clearly communicating roles, responsibilities, and expectations. Skills And Experience 3–4 years of relevant professional experience is preferred. At least 2–3 years of experience in data governance processes within data warehousing, ETL, and business intelligence environments. Experience with the full development lifecycle of an application or reporting solution, from design through testing and deployment.
